node.statement: Restriction to the identity component and descent. Let p:calU_e -> breve-calU=calU_e/U(1) be the orbit map and breve-e=[J]. The connected images mu(calU_e x calU_e) and sigma(calU_e) contain J by the exact basepoint identities, hence lie in the connected component calU_e; every admissible H-path whose initial point is in calU_e also lies in calU_e. The covariance identities therefore define continuous maps breve-mu([U],[V]):=[mu(U,V)] and breve-sigma([U]):=[sigma(U)], independent of representatives, and common-phase covariance makes each admissible projected straight path t |-> [H(t,U_0,U_1)] independent of a simultaneous replacement (U_0,U_1) by (cU_0,cU_1). For N>1 use the smooth quotient structure supplied by lem-stage1-quotient-manifold-package; for N=1, exact unitality and complex dimension one give calX=CJ, (cJ)^dagger=conj(c)J, (cJ) bold-dot (dJ)=cdJ, hence calU_e=U(1)J and breve-calU is the one-point smooth quotient. Thus the stated descents exist in every finite dimension.
